description: An infrared orthophoto displaying a mountainous landscape in Kebnekaise, Sweden. The image prominently features extensive areas of white, corresponding to glacier and perpetual snow. These icy features are surrounded by rugged terrain rendered in dark reddish-brown hues, which indicate exposed rock formations or sparse high-altitude vegetation in this infrared band combination. The image is credited to Lantmäteriet, Sweden. This type of imagery can be used for identifying land cover type CORINE Land Cover (CLC) class 3.3.5 (Glaciers and perpetual snow).
